Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You rush in behind a broad sweep, using the threat of the blade to claim a better position.

Rules

Action
Maneuver
Attribute
None — no roll
Target / range / shape
Self; a visible enemy you can approach by a legal route.
Duration
Movement is immediate; unused push benefit expires at turn end.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Repeatable; normal action economy applies.
Type
Signature

Move up to 3 squares toward that enemy without provoking. Your next Main Action melee attack this turn may push one of its targets 1 square directly away after resolution, on any result.

Additional rulings
